keyEvents.text: Liam Kitching (Sheffield United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sheffield United 1, Watford 0. Ben Brereton (Sheffield United) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Romelle Donovan.
Soumaïla Coulibaly (Watford) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Sheffield United 2, Watford 0. Ben Brereton (Sheffield United) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Martín Payero (Watford) is shown the yellow card.
Romelle Donovan (Sheffield United) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Sheffield United 2, Watford 0.
Ben Brereton (Sheffield United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Omar Haktab Traoré (Watford) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Watford. Amin Nabizada replaces Stephy Mavididi.
Substitution, Watford. Branimir Mlacic replaces Soumaïla Coulibaly.
Goal! Sheffield United 3, Watford 0. Jordan Ayew (Sheffield United) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tahith Chong with a cross.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Thomas Cannon replaces Romelle Donovan.
